title: Enforce Orchestrator != Authority: type every approver; reserve sponsor/security/release roles to humans
decided_at_provenance: RECORDED AT DECISION TIME. The AGREE was given in the operator session and this record was written in the same turn, before any implementation.

options_considered.B: reserve all four C3 roles incl. service_owner -- REJECTED (stricter than the mandate requires)
options_considered.C: NOT_AGREE -- proof and failing tests retained as evidence, no mutation -- REJECTED

authorizes.summary: Add human_reserved_roles to the authority matrix; add required principal_type to approvals and author_type to dossiers using the existing human|agent|service|controller vocabulary; refuse any non-human principal in a reserved role; refuse untyped approvers rather than assume human.
excluded: no role removed, no change class lowered, no reserved action changed
agent approvers remain valid for non-reserved roles

proven_defect: On canonical main: author orchestrator-agent, four distinct agent approvers for all four C3 roles including human_sponsor -> BADF GATE PASS, rendered verdict APPROVED, exit 0.
residual_risk: principal_type is self-declared text. This control makes a false declaration explicit and attributable; it does not make it impossible. The structural remedy remains a second identity (secb_pf condition C-7).

authority_downgrade.note: Strengthening only. Adds a constraint; removes none.

evidence: tests/test_badf_principal_type.py written before implementation: 7 of 9 failed on origin/main
CLI proof BEFORE: author orchestrator-agent + four agent approvers incl. human_sponsor -> APPROVED exit 0
CLI proof AFTER: same, typed honestly as agent -> 'role human_sponsor is human-reserved; a principal of type agent may not supply it' exit 1

RESIDUE MEASURED: same agents declaring principal_type 'human' -> APPROVED exit 0. The declaration is self-asserted; this control makes a false one explicit and attributable, not impossible. Structural remedy remains a second identity (secb_pf C-7).
monotonic guard extended: removing a human_reserved_role is a refused downgrade (2 tests failed first)
post-merge: the two skipped monotonic tests RAN and PASSED on canonical main 32c486d; pristine 158 OK
invalidation: Changing the reserved-role set, or the principal-type vocabulary, invalidates this decision; a new decision is required.
